detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for automated or scripted access patterns to the npm registry that involve repeated 404 responses for package names under your organization's scope, especially if accompanied by timing analysis. Look for external tools or scripts that measure and compare response times for these requests. Set up alerts for unusual enumeration activity or bursts of 404 errors targeting your private package namespaces.
